hard_evidence.classification: Authored hard; no hard source label is claimed
hard_evidence.backbone: Differentiate all supplied vector components, expand and simplify the sum of derivative squares, take the nonnegative norm, set up the integral on the stated interval. No integration.
hard_evidence.workload: Three nonzero product derivatives with chain rules, paired trig cross-term cancellation and positive exponential extraction. kb != na prevents a differentiated coefficient collapsing.
hard_evidence.bounds: All hard coefficients/frequencies/rates integer 1..3, exact ordered interval within [-2,7].
hard_evidence.validation: validation.json: 14 sampled exp_rotating records, at least 13 unique assessed tasks, displayed derivatives/norm stages and full options checked independently, native radio grading accepted/rejected.
